summary: aTyr Pharma filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement amending and restating its December 23, 2024 at-the-market offering program, covering the sale of up to $79,994,251 of common stock through Jefferies as sales agent under an Open Market Sale Agreement originally dated April 22, 2022 and amended December 23, 2024. Aggregate program capacity is $215.0 million, including $65.0 million sold before amendment; 445,732 shares were previously sold for roughly $70.0 million gross. Commission is up to 3.0% of gross sales price. Last reported price was $6.03 on November 5, 2026. No escrow applies; shares trade on Nasdaq Capital Market under ATYR.
